judge_assessment.explanation: The hard failure is exact and I reproduced it. final_response.md contains no filename, no path and not a single occurrence of 'pdf' in any case (grep -ic pdf returns 0); it opens 'Here are the three documents' and refers to them only as bold headings 'Worksheet', 'Answer key' and 'Study guide'. scripts/score_eval_run.py:502 response_surfaces requires either the artifact's filename or a '.pdf'/'pdfs' token together with the role phrase, so all three roles fail and three critical findings fire. Every other case in my slice names its files (for example curr-245's 'ws_pythag_curr245.pdf'), so this is a one-response omission, not a harness quirk. The judge is equally right that the mathematics is excellent: I re-solved all twelve - +-7; 2 and 3; -2 +- sqrt(3); 7 and -1; t = 0 and 3; 0 and 4; 5/2 and -1; w = 7 and -12; 1 and -5; 1/3 and -3/2; (40 + sqrt(1920))/32 = 2.6193... -> 2.62 s; and 9 and 21 break-even - and the contextual rejections (negative width, negative time, P(20) = 11 > 0 so the manager is wrong) are all correct. I also found a second instruction-following defect the judge did not name: final_response.md claims 'Two written parts are not machine-verified and are labelled as such on the page', but verify.json declares no manual entries at all and gate_log.txt reports '12 passed - 0 failed - 0 manual'. Problem 11's 'explain why the other root is thrown out' and problem 12(b) are genuinely open and were never declared, so the delivery message misstates the verification state as well as omitting the artifacts.

strengths_to_preserve: The Method line printed above the work space on every problem forces the student to commit to square roots, factoring or the quadratic formula before solving, and the key opens each solution by justifying that choice (no linear term -> square roots; perfect-square discriminant -> it factors; stalled factor hunt -> formula). That is the requested 'selecting efficient solution methods' skill made visible rather than assumed.

Problem 6 (3x^2 = 12x) is placed specifically to punish dividing both sides by x and losing the root x = 0, and problem 5's projectile keeps t = 0 as a meaningful root rather than discarding it - the sheet distinguishes roots that must be kept from roots that must be rejected.

The interpret-in-context items each reject a root for a stated physical reason and say so in the key: w = -12 is not a width, t = -0.1193 precedes the throw, and problem 12(b) computes P(20) = 11 to show the manager is wrong rather than merely asserting that 20 lies between the break-even values.

root_causes.description: The final response was written as a description of the three documents rather than as a delivery of three files. Nothing in the build or the skill requires the response to name the artifacts it produced, so a packet that passes every gate can still fail the delivery contract on wording alone.
evidence: final_response.md contains no '.pdf', no 'PDFs' and no filename; it begins 'Here are the three documents ...'.
scripts/score_eval_run.py:502-513 response_surfaces requires a filename or a '.pdf'/'pdfs' token plus the role phrase.
The three PDFs exist in the task directory (worksheet.pdf 5 pages, answer_key.pdf, study_guide.pdf) and gate_log.txt ends BUILD PASSED, so only the message failed.

root_causes.description: Two open written responses were never declared manual, and the delivery message asserted a labelling that does not exist in any artifact - so the only record of those items being open is a sentence in the response itself.
evidence: worksheet.pdf problem 11 asks the student to 'explain why the other root is thrown out'; problem 12(b) asks whether the manager is right and what happens between the roots.
verify.json contains no {'type': 'manual'} entry; gate_log.txt line 35 reads '12 passed - 0 failed - 0 manual'.
final_response.md states 'Two written parts are not machine-verified and are labelled as such on the page' - no such label appears in worksheet.tex, answer_key.tex or study_guide.tex.

improvements.title: Final response never names the three PDFs it produced
improvements.proposed_change: Make build.sh emit the delivered artifact list (role, filename, page count) as a block the final response must include, and add a check that the response text names every produced PDF by filename. SKILL.md should state the requirement in the same words the scorer uses: the response must name or link the worksheet, the answer key and the study guide as .pdf files.
improvements.regression_test: Add a test that feeds a response body describing 'the three documents' with no filename and no '.pdf' token to the artifact surfacing check and asserts a hard failure naming all three roles, then feeds a body listing the three filenames and asserts it passes. The first assertion fails today because no such check runs inside the build, and passes once build.sh gates on it.
improvements.expected_impact: Removes the single most avoidable rejection class in the run - this packet scored 4/4 on all seven content dimensions and was rejected for one missing word.
improvements.risk: A filename-matching check is brittle if the response renames files for the reader; accept either the generated filename or an explicit link to it, and keep the role phrases as a fallback.

improvements.title: Problems 11 and 12(b) are open responses declared nowhere but the delivery text
improvements.proposed_change: Add manual companion entries for problem 11's rejected-root explanation and problem 12(b)'s judgement, so the gate log reports them and the build exits 2. Add a lint that fails when the final response claims manual items that the verify JSON does not declare, so a delivery message cannot describe a labelling the artifacts do not carry.
improvements.regression_test: Add a test with a verify JSON containing zero manual entries and a final response asserting that some parts are labelled for manual review, and assert the check fails with a mismatch between claimed and declared manual items. It fails today (no such consistency check exists) and passes after the lint lands.
improvements.expected_impact: The manual count in the delivery message becomes derived from the verification data instead of written by hand, closing a class of false claims.
improvements.risk: The lint must parse free-form response prose; keep it to an explicit machine-readable summary block emitted by build.sh rather than a natural-language search.

case_summary: Mathematically the packet is excellent and the REJECT is entirely a delivery failure, exactly as the judge said. All twelve quadratics re-solve correctly, including the exact radical pair -2 +- sqrt(3), the fractional pair 1/3 and -3/2, the rounded landing time 2.62 s and the break-even roots 9 and 21; every contextual rejection is justified physically rather than asserted; the Method line on each problem makes method selection the visible skill. The response that delivered it, however, never uses the word PDF and never names a file, so all three artifacts count as unsurfaced and three critical findings fire. A second defect compounds it: the same response claims two written parts are 'labelled as such on the page', but verify.json declares no manual entries and the gate log records '0 manual' - problem 11's explanation and problem 12(b) were never flagged anywhere.
